Hi everyone! What a surprise! The launch was supposed to be tomorrow, but as fate would have it, I'm going on a trip tomorrow and will be busy. So... what a stroke of luck to be launching this new story, hehehe.
So, what is this new story about?

This story focuses on two protagonists. One of them, Kaede, is a special operations spy, while her friend Aura is a Major in the military. Both of them belong to Astoria. However, a few weeks ago, an incident occurred in the neighboring country of Ostara: complete silence across all communications and trade. Astoria will send our two protagonists to investigate what happened in the neighboring country and find out what has taken place.

I hope you enjoy it and share your thoughts on this new story. Greetings to all, and thank you for your support!

If you want the story, you can support me in Fanbox and you will get a download link for you to keep! (Includes all my previous work and stories!)
Fanbox: https://inquisidor77.fanbox.cc/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/Inquisidor77

I would like to thank the content creator wk117 for publishing the EvilFall outfits on Pixiv for Koikatsu. I would also like to thank the Pixiv content creator Krogen for showing me some drone material, as well as some of his own creations.
And, of course, I would also like to thank Darkflame for being the inspiration behind these stories.
